Do not co-locate transmitter with other antennas or transmitters

steps: Short press the Distress button
Select nature of distress from provided list
Follow prompts to complete distress call

procedures.title: Initiating Immediate Undesignated Distress Call
steps: Long press the Distress button
Hold until transmission begins
procedures.expected_outcome: Immediate undesignated distress call is broadcast to all DSC radios in range

procedures.title: Switching to Priority Channel 16
steps: Short press the 16/9 button
To return to original channel, press 16/9 button again
procedures.expected_outcome: Radio switches to Channel 16 and back to original channel when pressed again

procedures.title: Setting Channel 09 as Priority Channel
preconditions: Radio is in US/CAN country mode
steps: Long press the 16/9 button
procedures.expected_outcome: Channel 09 becomes the priority channel

procedures.title: Monitoring Battery Level
steps: Check for low battery warning icon on display
Warning activates at 10.5V
procedures.expected_outcome: User is alerted of low vessel battery condition

procedures.title: Navigate Menu System
steps: Use scroll bar to see additional options above/below displayed menu text
Select menu item by highlighting it
Press OK/HL key to make selections
Press X/POWER key to go back to previous menu or exit completely
procedures.expected_outcome: Successfully navigate and select menu options

procedures.title: Enter Alphanumeric Data
steps: Press up/down keys to scroll through alphanumeric characters
Alternatively use keypad on wired handset to enter text
Press OK/HL key to select character and move to next position
Press DSC/MENU key to move back one character
Press X/POWER key to cancel entry and return to previous menu
procedures.expected_outcome: Successfully enter alphanumeric text

procedures.title: System Startup Display Check
steps: Observe splash screen displays brand
Verify model is shown
Confirm country mode appears
Check software version is displayed
Verify MMSI number appears
procedures.expected_outcome: All startup information displayed correctly

procedures.title: Power Level Selection
steps: Select between High (25W) power mode
Select between Low (1W) power mode
Verify correct power indicator icon displays
procedures.expected_outcome: Desired power level selected and indicated

procedures.title: Display Settings Adjustment
steps: Access display settings menu
Adjust contrast level as needed
Adjust brightness level as needed
Enable/disable night-time backlight inversion
procedures.expected_outcome: Display settings optimized for viewing conditions

procedures.title: Power On/Off System
steps: Long press X/POWER key to turn system ON
System can only be turned OFF from Fixed Handset 1 (F1)
For handsets F2-F4: Long press X key to turn that specific handset OFF
For handsets W1-W4: Long press X key to toggle that handset OFF/ON
procedures.expected_outcome: Radio system power state changed as requested

procedures.title: Transmit Message (PTT)
steps: Press and hold PTT key
Speak message
Release PTT when done speaking
procedures.expected_outcome: Message transmitted successfully

procedures.title: Channel Navigation
steps: Short press Channel UP to increase one channel
Short press Channel DOWN to decrease one channel
Long press either key to rapidly scroll through channels
Alternatively, directly type channel number on keypad
procedures.expected_outcome: Desired channel selected

procedures.title: Set Priority Channel 09
preconditions: Must be in US/CAN country mode
steps: Long press C X/POWER button
procedures.expected_outcome: Channel 09 set as priority channel

procedures.title: Transmission Power Control
steps: Long press OK/HL key to toggle between HIGH (25W) and LOW (1W) power
For restricted channels: Press and hold H/L after PTT to override to high power
Keep H/L pressed after releasing PTT for continued high power transmission
procedures.expected_outcome: Transmission power changed between HIGH/LOW as requested

procedures.title: Volume/Squelch Control
steps: Short press VOL/SQL Selector to toggle between Volume and Squelch control
Use + key to increase selected control
Use - key to decrease selected control
procedures.expected_outcome: Volume or squelch level adjusted as desired

procedures.title: Access DSC Call Menu
steps: Short press DSC/MENU key
procedures.expected_outcome: DSC Call Menu opened

procedures.title: Access AIS Mode
steps: Short press AIS/IC key
procedures.expected_outcome: AIS mode activated

procedures.title: Normal Mode Key Operations
steps: Press 0 briefly for digit 0, or long press for Hailer mode menu
Press 1 briefly for digit 1, or long press for Horn mode menu
Press 2 briefly for digit 2, or long press for Alarms configuration menu
Press 3 briefly for digit 3, or long press for Speaker setup ON/OFF
Press 4 briefly for digit 4, or long press for Diagnostics - Handsets
Press 5 briefly for digit 5, or long press for Position display
Press 6 briefly for digit 6, or long press for Navigation mode
Press 7 briefly for digit 7, or long press for Speakers configuration menu
Press 8 briefly for digit 8, or long press for AIS Silent mode menu
Press 9 briefly for digit 9, or long press for My channels
procedures.expected_outcome: Corresponding function is activated based on key press duration

procedures.title: Data Input Mode Operations
steps: Press 0 briefly for 0, long press for blank character/space
Press 1 briefly for 1
Press 2 briefly to cycle through 2, A, B, C
Press 3 briefly to cycle through 3, D, E, F
Press 4 briefly to cycle through 4, G, H, I
Press 5 briefly to cycle through 5, J, K, L
Press 6 briefly to cycle through 6, M, N, O
Press 7 briefly to cycle through 7, P, Q, R, S
Press 8 briefly to cycle through 8, T, U, V
Press 9 briefly to cycle through 9, W, X, Y, Z
procedures.expected_outcome: Selected character is entered after short pause or pressing different key

procedures.title: Intercom Mode Operations
steps: Press 0 briefly to call all IC stations, long press for All PA announce tone
Press 1 briefly for direct call to Handset-1
Press 2 briefly for direct call to Handset-2
Press 3 briefly for direct call to Handset-3
Press 4 briefly for direct call to Handset-4
Press 5 briefly for direct call to Handset-5
Press 6 briefly for direct call to Handset-6
Press 7 briefly for direct call to Handset-7
Press 8 briefly for direct call to Handset-8
procedures.expected_outcome: Direct connection established with selected handset or all stations

procedures.title: Intercom/Hailer/Fog Horn/Announce Mode Access
steps: Long press M Weather button
procedures.expected_outcome: Enter Intercom/Hailer/Fog Horn/Announce mode

procedures.title: Weather Station Access - US/CAN Mode
steps: Short press M Weather button
procedures.expected_outcome: Hear most recently selected NOAA/Canadian weather station

procedures.title: Weather Channel Storage - Non US/CAN Mode
preconditions: Radio in non US/CAN country mode
steps: Long press M Weather button
procedures.expected_outcome: Current channel stored as weather, local harbor or preferred channel

procedures.title: ALL SCAN Mode Operation

procedures.expected_outcome: Enter ALL SCAN mode

procedures.expected_outcome: AIS plotter scale adjusted

procedures.title: Watch Mode Operation

procedures.expected_outcome: Watch mode activated

procedures.title: Watch Channel Setting
steps: Long press to set current channel as watch channel
procedures.expected_outcome: Watch channel set

procedures.title: Man Over Board (MOB) Marking
steps: Long press SCAN and TRI keys simultaneously
procedures.expected_outcome: Current location marked with MOB waypoint

procedures.title: Voice Recorder Playback
steps: Short press voice recorder button
procedures.expected_outcome: Last 60 seconds of VHF radio traffic replayed

procedures.title: Voice Recorder Menu Access
steps: Long press voice recorder button
procedures.expected_outcome: Voice Recorder menu opened

procedures.title: Numeric Keypad Operation - Normal Mode
steps: Short press: Enter numeric digit
Long Press: Open pre-determined function or menu
procedures.expected_outcome: Desired number entered or function accessed

procedures.title: Numeric Keypad Operation - Data Input Mode
steps: Short press to enter numeric digit
Subsequent presses enter letters
Wait for short pause or press different key to accept letter
procedures.expected_outcome: Desired character entered

procedures.title: Numeric Keypad Operation - Intercom Mode
steps: Short press to make direct call to another intercom station
procedures.expected_outcome: Direct intercom call initiated

steps: Long press the DSC/MENU key
procedures.expected_outcome: Main Menu page opens

steps: Select Scan option
